name: claude-code-harness
description: Dev-only manifest for tests and lint. Not copied by the installer; runtime stays zero-dep.

scripts.test: node --test hooks/__tests__/*.test.js trackers/__tests__/*.test.js code-platform/__tests__/*.test.js install/__tests__/*.test.js skills/*/__tests__/*.test.js
scripts.test:coverage: c8 --reporter=text --reporter=lcov node --test hooks/__tests__/*.test.js trackers/__tests__/*.test.js code-platform/__tests__/*.test.js install/__tests__/*.test.js skills/*/__tests__/*.test.js
scripts.lint: eslint hooks/ trackers/__tests__/ code-platform/__tests__/ install/ skills/*/__tests__/
